ui.q1: How do I view previous Claude Code sessions?
ui.a1: Claude Code saves every session as a JSONL file under ~/.claude/projects/<project>/<session-id>.jsonl. Drop the file here to browse the full conversation.
ui.q2: Is my session file uploaded anywhere?
ui.a2: No. Parsing happens entirely in your browser with no API calls and no server upload. Session files contain your code, file paths and sometimes secrets — which is exactly why this tool is 100% client-side.
ui.a3: Markdown rendering for user and assistant messages, extended thinking blocks, tool call parameters and results, images, token usage and cost stats — with an interface in 10 languages.
ui.a4: JSON Lines — one independent JSON object per line. Claude Code logs every message, tool call and metadata entry as a line.
ui.a5: Yes, it is free and open-source. No sign-up required.
